description: Migration script for copying and transforming dataset and table models in a database schema, including functions for copying tables, datasets, columns, metrics, and post-processing steps during upgrade/downgrade operations.

classes.name: AuxiliaryColumnsMixin
classes.description: Mixin adding auxiliary columns like created_on, changed_on, created_by_fk, changed_by_fk.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Model representing a database connection with URI and credentials.

classes.name: TableColumn
classes.description: Model representing a table column with metadata.

classes.name: SqlMetric
classes.description: Model representing a SQL metric with expression and metadata.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: Model representing a SQLAlchemy table with database linkage.

classes.name: NewColumn
classes.description: Temporary model for new columns during migration.

classes.name: NewTable
classes.description: Temporary model for new tables during migration.

classes.name: NewDataset
classes.description: Temporary model for new datasets during migration.

methods.name: get_db_engine_spec
methods.description: Returns the database engine specification based on a SQLAlchemy URI.

methods.name: insert_from_select
methods.description: Executes an INSERT FROM SELECT operation to copy data between tables.

methods.name: find_tables
methods.description: Finds table IDs in a specific database matching a set of table references.

methods.name: copy_tables
methods.description: Copies physical tables from existing schema to new schema.

methods.name: copy_datasets
methods.description: Copies datasets from existing tables to new dataset models.

methods.name: copy_columns
methods.description: Copies columns associated with tables to new column models.

methods.name: postprocess_datasets
methods.description: Post-processes datasets to quote table names and link tables.

methods.name: postprocess_columns
methods.description: Post-processes columns to add quotes and extra metadata.

methods.name: reset_postgres_id_sequence
methods.description: Resets PostgreSQL sequence for a table's ID.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema upgrade, copying data and post-processing.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops temporary tables and reverts schema changes.
